title: Miss I. I. Kleiner, Ex-Soviet Employee

page_data.en:

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch
REPORT
Date November 17, 1933.

Subject (in full) Miss I.I. Kleiner, ex-Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

Information has been received that Isabela Ilinishna
Kleiner was formerly in the employ of the local branch of the
United Petroleum Trust of U.S.S.R. (Soyzneft), from November
1931 until December 1932 when she resigned. Later she re-
joined this firm but was employed for a few months only.
Miss Kleiner is a Russian Jewess, born in 1910 at
Irkutsk, Siberia. Her father was for several years with the
Gosstrah (Government Insurance Co.) at Moscow. A few years
ago he was transferred to Harbin and removed all his property,
furniture etc. to this city, this being allowed only to the
trustworthy Soviet employees. Her mother is a sister of one
J.R. Kuroth, a suspected Soviet Agent (File D.4414 & D.4749).
Miss Kleiner arrived at Shanghai from Harbin in
1931 accompanied by her mother. She registered with the
Bureau of Public Safety as a Soviet Citizen on May 2, 1931
under No.4789.
When in Shanghai she resided at No.148 Seymour Road
from 15/10/31 to 31/3/32, at No.16 Hedhurst Road from 1/10/32
to 7/7/33 when she removed to her present address, No.159,
Avenue Haig, house 28, which is occupied by her mother Mrs.
E. Kleiner.

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

[Signature]
[Signature]

（左侧批注：* Cross Indexed）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科
报告
日期：1933年11月17日。

主题（全称）：I.I. 克莱纳小姐，前苏联雇员。

制作人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基 转呈人：[签名]

接获情报称，伊莎贝拉·伊利尼什娜·克莱纳（Isabela Ilinishna Kleiner）曾受雇于苏联联合石油托拉斯（Soyzneft）上海分部，任职时间为1931年11月至1932年12月辞职期间。此后她曾重返该机构，但仅受雇数月。

克莱纳小姐系俄罗斯犹太裔，1910年生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克。其父曾在莫斯科国家保险公司（Gosstrah）工作数年。数年前，他被调往哈尔滨，并将其所有财产、家具等迁至该市，此举仅被允许给予值得信任的苏联雇员。其母是J.R. 库罗思（J.R. Kuroth，音译）的姐妹，库罗思是一名涉嫌苏联特工的人员（档案号 D.4414 及 D.4749）。

克莱纳小姐于1931年由其母陪同从哈尔滨抵达上海。她于1931年5月2日以苏联公民身份在公共安全局登记，编号为4789。

在上海期间，她于1931年10月15日至1932年3月31日居住在西摩路148号；于1932年10月1日至1933年7月7日居住在赫德赫斯特路16号；随后搬至现址，即海格路159号28室，该处由其母E. 克莱纳夫人居住。

G. 切列姆尚斯基
D. S.
特务科主管警官。

[签名]
[签名]
